latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Pear - iCloud Calendar, Reminders & Contacts skill.

- Provides 27 tools for managing iCloud calendar events, reminders, and contacts via Pear API (CalDAV/CardDAV).
- Supports scheduling, daily briefings, contact and group management, reminders, event creation, updates, deletions, and AI meeting time suggestions.
- Requires a PEAR_API_KEY and network access to pearmcp.com.
- Includes detailed usage guidelines for dates, scheduling, and safety confirmations.
- Not compatible with Apple Notes, Mail, iMessage, iCloud Drive, or other non-PIM Apple services.
